brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Storage for small sewing notions (buttons, pins, needles, beads) kept sorted and tidy
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 provide 3-compartment full-depth trays (6 sorted sections total) for small notions; bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 provides 2-compartment tray for larger items like bobbins/spools

accessory:0#1,0#1 hex-acc-rod (Rod socket) on outside face of piece:1,0,0;full provides vertical mast for thread spool/conduit riser; dedicated 2-compartment bin (bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2) holds additional spools upright

requirements.requirement: Hanging for sewing tools (scissors, seam ripper, tape measure)
requirements.evidence: accessory:0#1,0#0 hex-acc-hook (Hook plate with 2 hooks) on outside face of piece:1,0,0;full for hanging tools without committing whole face to rail

requirements.requirement: Stable, tidy modular build that can sit on desk/shelf
requirements.evidence: 3x piece full bases in triangular cluster (0,0,0 + 0,1,0 + 1,0,0) joined with connector:0#0,0|0,1 and jointBolt:0#0,0#0, jointBolt:0#0,0#5 - check_build ok true meshClash clear, no LOOSE_BODY errors

finish.summary: Built compact 3-cell triangular sewing caddy: two 3-compartment bins for sorted small notions (buttons, pins, needles), one 2-compartment bin for bobbins/spools, plus Hook plate for scissors/tools and Rod socket for vertical spool holder. Cluster is locked with side connector and joint bolts, mesh verified clear - tidy desk/shelf organizer for sewing supplies.

M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
